newsitem.title: DUBAI: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - Aug 19.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - Aug 19.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the United Arab Emirates' (UAE) press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Saudi Arabia assured the United States it would reconsider its decision to boycott the forthcoming Middle East and North Africa summit if the Israeli-Palestinian situation improves, a U.S. diplomat says.
- Sharjah is to set up a natural gas network in a bid to boost its position as a major industrial hub in the UAE.
- An exhibition on luxurious goods and products will be held in Dubai from September 24 to 27 alongside the Motexa autumn fashion, textile and leather products fair.
- Bhoja Air, a Pakistani private airline, will introduce two weekly passenger services between Dubai and Multan in Pakistan's Punjab province from the second week of October.
- Ther German state of Bavaria will participate in a major promotion of tableware in Dubai next month. The move follows a 25 percent increase in exports to the UAE in the first quarter of the year.
- Demand for Abu Dhabi Islamic Bank shares soars.
- An Iranian official says Tehran ready to sign peace treaty with Iraq.
- UAE trade with Taiwan reaches 1.2 billion dirhams in the first half of this year.
